newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-KONYSHEV WINS MASS DASH TO THE LINE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-KONYSHEV WINS MASS DASH TO THE LINE.

text.p: Russian Dmitry Konyshev headed a mass finish to the ninth stage of the Giro d'Italia from Cava de' Tirreni on Sunday.
He edged out Italians Mariano Piccoli and Roberto Petito after the 232 km haul, longest section of the three-week race to date.
Petito's third place earned a four seconds time deduction which brought him within two seconds of third overall.
Konyshev's compatriot Pavel Tonkov still rules by 41 seconds from Frenchman Luc Leblanc. He has now worn the leader's pink jersey for a week.
Konyshev has carried the colours of best intermediate sprinter since the Giro began in Venice nine days ago.
